open_points.subject: Registry storage boundary
open_points.text: “Registry stores identity and pointers only” contradicts “Registry holds a Customer record: who the project is for and how to reach them — name, phone, e-mail, language.”
open_points.question: Does the storage boundary include Registry-owned customer contact data, or must Registry truly store only project identity and artifact pointers?
options: Treat customer contact data as an explicit exception to the identity-and-pointers-only statement
Remove customer contact data from Registry
Define customer contact data as part of the identity covered by the statement
open_points.default_guess: Treat R0-06 as controlling and make customer contact data an explicit exception.

open_points.subject: Acceptance date and scope
open_points.text: “Accepted by the owner as a whole on 2026-10-26” conflicts with R0-19 and R0-20, which are owner decisions dated 2026-10-27 and are now part of the document accepted “as a whole.”
open_points.question: Were R0-19 and R0-20 separately accepted amendments, or was the whole document accepted or re-accepted on 2026-10-27?
options: The whole document was re-accepted on 2026-10-27
R0-19 and R0-20 were separately accepted amendments to the 2026-10-26 baseline
R0-19 and R0-20 are not yet accepted
open_points.default_guess: Treat R0-19 and R0-20 as accepted amendments made on 2026-10-27.

open_points.subject: Decision provenance claim
open_points.text: “every decision below names the v1 decision (V1-n) or the legacy finding (Ln) it keeps, narrows or replaces” is false for decisions including R0-10, R0-15, R0-16, R0-17, R0-19 and R0-20, which name no such V1-n or Ln provenance.
open_points.question: Must each of these decisions be tied to a specific V1 or legacy finding, or should the status allow decisions that are new owner choices without such provenance?
options: Add the missing V1-n or Ln provenance to every decision
State that some decisions are new owner choices with no V1 or legacy antecedent
open_points.default_guess: Allow explicitly new owner decisions without V1-n or Ln provenance and qualify the status claim.
